title: Public Cloudflare deployment
voiceover: This is the deployed Proof-Carrying Cashier, running on its own Cloudflare Pages domain. The site states the T1 custody boundary, current test evidence, and the latest accepted proof.

visual.intent: Independent public domain. Real product surface.

title: Judge review path
voiceover: The review pack puts the recorded workflow, public evidence, source, release, and independent verification in one place. Next, open the accepted settlement in the live proof ledger.

title: Inspect the proof
voiceover: The proof view recomputes the offer hash, settlement hash, Ed25519 attestations, and linkage. The witness view exposes the recorded validator observation. Raw shows the portable signed bundle itself.

visual.intent: Proof, witness, and raw signed artifact.

title: Verify outside the site
voiceover: Now run the copied command outside the website. It downloads the Cloudflare proof, ignores the hosted verdict, and independently checks fourteen ledger and cryptographic conditions. The verifier exits zero.

title: Evidence before trust
voiceover: This demo is a real browser and terminal recording. The signed payment evidence is localnet and labeled as such. Public-network receipts still require two distinct HTTPS RPC witnesses.
